construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in this isolated build directory.

input.citizen_service_request: Government form JSON: SYN-REQ case_number, SYN-PERSONA persona_id, NOT-A-REAL-ADDRESS plus three digits, and enumerated service.
input.preferences: Exactly turnaround, fee, accessibility, online: finite weights from 0 through 100, positive total.
input.options: One through thirty options; unique SYN-OPT identifiers and SYN-APP application case numbers, label, benefits_application, policy_document, attributes.
input.benefits_application: Government form JSON: case_number, request_case_number matching shared request, status illustrative.
input.policy_document: SYN-POL identifier and at most 4000 characters of invented policy/regulation text prefixed SYNTHETIC POLICY: .
input.attributes: Exactly turnaround, fee, accessibility, online. Each is null or an object with value and unit. No unrecognized fields.

output.success: schema_version, status ok, synthetic, minimized citizen_service_request, side-by-side comparison, normalized options with linked application and policy identifiers, ranking, summary, review.
output.error: schema_version, status error, static or sanitized message; exit code 2.

units.online: boolean true/false or yes/no converted to boolean

shared_schema.validation: One shared validate boundary rejects unknown fields, broken links, duplicate identifiers, invalid numeric values, unsupported units and non-synthetic records. CLI additionally rejects malformed UTF-8/JSON, duplicate JSON fields, nonfinite constants, and inputs above 256000 bytes.

cross_stage_handoffs: Shared validation produces minimized request, normalized attribute values, and normalized preference weights.
The same normalized options supply both side-by-side rows and deterministic preference scoring.
Ranking and its per-attribute explanations use identical contributions and preserve synthetic application/policy references.

behavior.normalization: Turnaround and fee prefer lower values; accessibility and online prefer higher values. Numeric input values are bounded at 1000000, accessibility additionally at 100 percent or rating 5.
behavior.ranking: Numeric points use comparison-local min/max scaling; equal available numeric values get 1. Online true gets 1, false gets 0. Weighted sum uses normalized weights. Sort by descending score, then option identifier.
behavior.missing_data: Explicit null means unknown and scores zero without redistribution. All-null attribute ranges are null. Entirely missing evidence can produce zero-score ties, not a benefits decision.
behavior.review: Each option exposes normalized facts, point calculation direction, weights, weighted contributions, total score, missing values, and policy identifier. Policy prose is context only and is not used to infer eligibility.
industry_constraints: Synthetic-only government form fixtures use invented case numbers, fabricated persona identifiers, and non-traceable address markers.
Strict input field allowlists and illustrative email/phone/identity-pattern screening limit PII; outputs omit persona, address, and policy prose. Errors do not echo rejected data.
Explainable advisory rankings support review in the spirit of FOIA/open records, without making legal determinations.
Plain-language summaries, explicit units and text explanations do not depend on color or images, in the spirit of Section 508.

included: Bounded deterministic comparison of supplied public-sector service alternatives
Single shared JSON input/output contract and validation layer
Synthetic government forms and invented policy/regulation text
excluded: Live search, network requests, model providers, and LLM steps
Real citizen PII processing or comprehensive free-text PII detection
Benefits eligibility decisions, legal interpretation, and compliance certification
Automatic extraction or verification of attributes from policy prose
Production identity, persistence, authorization, audit storage, and accessible web UI
